changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'AssetType' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'HashValue' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo') BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.AssetType ADD [HashValue] [binary](20) NULL END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'AssetType' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'HashValue' AND TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo') BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.AssetType DROP COLUMN HashValue END
